Located in the dynamic and highly developed Minhang District of Shanghai, China, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. stands as a premier enterprise in the fine chemical and life science industries. Established with a strong commitment to advancing scientific research and industrial manufacturing, Meryer has steadily grown into a leading comprehensive supplier of high-quality research chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, and specialized biochemicals. The company operates at the critical intersection of innovation and reliability, serving as a trusted partner to pharmaceutical and biotech companies, prestigious universities, and renowned research institutions both in China and around the globe.

Meryer's expansive product portfolio features tens of thousands of catalog chemicals, carefully curated to meet the diverse and rapidly evolving needs of the modern scientific community. Beyond supplying standard catalog items, the company excels in providing tailored chemical solutions, including complex custom synthesis and scale-up production services. This operational flexibility allows Meryer to seamlessly support its clients' projects from early-stage laboratory discovery and drug development all the way through to commercial manufacturing.

At the core of Meryer’s success is an unwavering dedication to strict quality assurance and technological innovation. The company operates state-of-the-art laboratory facilities equipped with advanced analytical instruments and enforces a rigorous quality control system, ensuring that every product meets the highest international standards for purity and consistency. Driven by a dedicated team of highly skilled chemists and experienced industry professionals, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. continues to push the boundaries of chemical excellence. By fostering a customer-centric approach, Meryer not only contributes significantly to the thriving chemical sector in Shanghai but also plays an essential role in accelerating global scientific and pharmaceutical breakthroughs.
